reddit.title: Introducing Materials Instead of Cost Badges in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share a significant update in Provincia! Our new system replaces the confusing cost chips with a clear Materials sheet for each paid build entry. Now you can easily see the stored vs required materials for your buildings, with shortages highlighted for your convenience. This change enhances your building experience, allowing you to plan better without the guesswork. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges

steam.title: Provincia Update: Materials Instead of Cost Badges
steam.body: We're thrilled to announce a major improvement in Provincia! The confusing cost badges have been replaced with a detailed Materials sheet for each paid build entry. This allows you to see all the materials you need at a glance, including what's stored and what's required. No more hidden costs—just clear and actionable information to enhance your building experience. Learn more about this update and how it can improve your gameplay here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges
